⌖ HOW THE PLATFORM WORKS

From data capture to defect resolution

  1. 01

    Data capture

    Autonomous drones fly preset routes, capturing photo, video, LiDAR and sensor data.

  2. 02

    Data transfer

    Telemetry streams seamlessly into a single system.

  3. 03

    AI analysis

    Computer vision automatically detects and classifies defects.

  4. 04

    Visualization

    Precise 2D/3D models and a full digital twin of the asset.

  5. 05

    O&M management

    Alerts are generated, work is assigned to crews, and completion is tracked.

A closed control loop — everything inside one digital contour.
